profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | Physics PhD
profile.summary: I have a passion for science and technology and their application towards the betterment of all people and towards an amazing future for everyone.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
● Lead Full-Stack Developer on multiple projects responsible for designing and building PEAN stacks (PostgreSQL, Express.js, Angular, and Node.js) ranging from 6-month prototypes to multi-year projects on various drone and robotics applications.
● Example projects include a) user interface for mission planning and execution with client server and database for swarming drone system, b) web app and server for running orbital simulations and visualization of results in 3D, and c) user interface for drone-based live mapping and object detection using a trained ML model.
● Built multi-architecture Docker images for deployment on drones and ground station computers and utilized CI/CD pipelines and AWS Elastic Container Repository (ECR) to store and deploy images.
● Led the Analytics Group, a group of software and machine learning engineers, and ensured team was properly utilized by monitoring work load across projects and collaborating with project leads as well as fostered career and skill development for each member.
● Configured and managed AWS EC2 instances for internal git and wiki servers
● Managed software development for multiple projects by collecting requirements, creating diagrams and work breakdowns, grooming and assigning tickets in Jira, and leading standups.
● Collaborated with project leads and hardware engineers to understand software needs. Regularly present updates on software progress and blockers.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
● Designed and built a tech stack from scratch to facilitate Covid testing at over 1000 sites with over 3000 end-users with rapidly changing scope and product requirements as the pandemic evolved, including database infrastructure, front-end applications (tools, dashboards, order forms), internal API, and cloud-based server infrastructure.
● Acted as a touchpoint for other internal teams in order to expand operational capabilities and advise on solutions.
● Managed the development processes for the product team to review, test, and deploy architecture and code with an emphasis on scalability. resilience, and security. 
● Led team’s daily standups and acted as a resource for other team members. Worked with the team to assign workloads that supported developing new skills while having a direct and immediate impact on live and upcoming products.

positions.title: Testing Logistics Associate
positions.description:
● Coordinated external vendors, collected and analyzed data, and developed processes and systems to provide COVID-19 testing to students and staff at Massachusetts schools.
● Organized logistics to provide testing to 500 schools over 80 school districts statewide at a high service level (NPS score of 75).
● Designed and created dashboards, automation tools,  databases, workflow processes, and quality control systems.
● Took the lead on sub-projects including revamping onboarding process for new districts and on site staff training.

positions.title: Server
positions.description:
● Manage multiple competing priorities in fast-paced working conditions.
● Interact with customers and ensure customer satisfaction.
● Take on a management role as needed including overseeing operations, troubleshooting, and customer care.
● Thrived in rapidly changing conditions and regulations of post-Covid-19 lockdown re-opening.

positions.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
positions.description:
● Successfully led a research project to upscale production of nanomaterial to commercially viable quantities.
● Defined and controlled scope of project to keep project on target while also being adaptable to take advantage of new developments from experiments.
● Acquired and controlled lab resources to meet project goals within time limit of 1 year and within cost.
● Communicated with stakeholders to obtain requirements, manage expectations, and foster stakeholder engagement.
● Identified project risks and planned risk responses to minimize project threats and maximize opportunities.
● Communicated progress and results in formal presentations and informal meetings.
● Managed lab knowledge through creation of process and training documentation.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Analytical Skills · JavaScript · Programming

positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description:
● Presented university level physics lectures in large auditoriums of hundreds of students and group focused workshops.
● Responsible for organization and presentation of curriculum with little direction from the department.

positions.title: Doctoral Research Associate
positions.description:
● Fundamental physics research on novel nanomaterials, Bismuth Selenide and Molybdenum Disulfide, including material growth and synthesis, characterization of electrical and optical properties, and potential applications.
● Independent research including self-taught analysis methods, programming, software, and equipment construction and operation.
● Published 3 scientific papers in high-impact journals and presented findings at multiple conferences.
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging · Analytical Skills · JavaScript · Programming
